peak_pose: both hands lifting her pigtails up behind her head, back deeply arched, chest lifted forward toward the viewer, ribcage stretched, chin raised
expression: eyes half-closed in a slow sultry look down at the viewer, soft parted lips
motion: She slowly lifts both pigtails up behind her head and arches her back, chest rising forward; she releases her hair with a slow toss so the pigtails fall and swing, and her chest drops into a soft, delayed double bounce; then she lowers her arms back to the start pose.
name: hair_toss_arch
